cases.name: Alexander the coppersmith
cases.charge: Doing Paul much evil; greatly withstanding his words
cases.preview: In the uproar at Ephesus the Jews put Alexander forward out of the multitude to make a defence, and the crowd shouted him down for about two hours once they knew what he was (Acts 19:33-34).
